services.jope-parallel-gp:
# /etc/systemd/system/jope-parallel-gp.service
[Unit]
Description=JOPE adaptive GP teacher data generation
After=jope-parallel-monitor.service
Requires=jope-parallel-monitor.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/bin/jope-parallel-cpu-v44 --root /home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel gp-service --manifest /home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/manifests/generated/gp-expanded-vocabulary-jobs.json --workers 104 --threads 1
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
MemoryHigh=900G
MemoryMax=1100G
MemorySwapMax=0
TasksMax=2048
CPUAccounting=true
MemoryAccounting=true
Nice=5
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
services.jope-parallel-campaign:
# /etc/systemd/system/jope-parallel-campaign.service
[Unit]
Description=JOPE bounded regression qualification campaign on a frozen 64-family cohort
After=jope-parallel-monitor.service jope-parallel-gp.service
Requires=jope-parallel-monitor.service jope-parallel-gp.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/bin/jope-parallel-neural-v44 --root /home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel campaign --spec /home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/manifests/generated/campaign64-qualification-v1.json
Environment=JOPE_GP_EXECUTABLE=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/bin/jope-parallel-cpu-v44
Environment=OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
Environment=RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2
Environment=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
Environment=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
CPUAffinity=60 61 122 123
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=20
RuntimeMaxSec=24h
MemoryHigh=96G
MemoryMax=128G
MemorySwapMax=0
TasksMax=512
CPUAccounting=true
MemoryAccounting=true
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
services.jope-parallel-monitor:
# /etc/systemd/system/jope-parallel-monitor.service
[Unit]
Description=JOPE parallel hardware telemetry
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel/bin/jope-parallel-tui-v27 --root /home/ubuntu/jope-dime/parallel monitor
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
MemoryMax=1G
TasksMax=32
CPUAffinity=60 61
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
